# External data backbone

**Provider:** UCI Machine Learning Repository  
**Dataset:** Condition monitoring of hydraulic systems  
**Source:** https://archive.ics.uci.edu/dataset/447/condition+monitoring+of+hydraulic+systems  
**DOI/reference:** 10.24432/C5CW21  
**License/terms:** CC BY 4.0

Advertised source scale: 2,205 60-second hydraulic test-rig cycles with pressure, flow, temperature, vibration and component-condition labels.

Run `./data/external/fetch_public_data.ps1` on an internet-connected Windows machine to refresh the public source. Offline acceptance uses repository reference evidence and never relabels that fixture as external observation.
